result.summary: One spec for G5 with one unit, D22 NIGHTLY-LEARNING. It is scripts-only and adds no migration and no app/ file. The new file scripts/cron_learning.py reads its flag as the first statement of main through kb_seed_common.run_mode. Unset or garbage means OFF: one INFO line and exit 0, with no client, no argparse and no kb_leaf. true means DRY: report only. The word apply means one upsert into kb_coverage_daily on (day, metric), with every row built by build_coverage_row, using D17's exact call shape. The job uses no LLM, no Serper and no other network. It reads with paged, id-ordered, capped reads over a window of whole UTC days ending at the previous midnight. The tables are comparison_feedback, verdict_critiques, user_events, search_logs, kb_gaps and kb_feedback. Before 045 is applied, a missing kb_* table is a counted skip. It then reads comparisons by id through PostgREST JSON paths and kb_specs by product_id for grounding. Measured facts the spec relies on: (1) comparisons has NO category_used column; the category lives at full_response.category_used (response_builder.py:2286). (2) No code writes kb_feedback, so identity_wrong stays 0. (3) user_events does carry comparison_id but names no field, so it feeds context metrics only. (4) The judge is absent and ENABLE_SELF_CRITIQUE has no ledger line, so it is treated as unknown and default OFF. verdict_unsupported fires when missing_citation or bias is below 7. (5) shadow_experiments has no $0 replay: its replay step calls OpenAI. The output contract covers: six buckets; clusters by category x source x field (source = the price source_method, mixed or unknown, or a fixed label); the systematic rule with user_id named as a proxy for a device; proposals with judge_state pending and a closed action vocabulary, never applied; exemplar candidates per category, versioned as day plus a base32 content hash; eval candidates; and a de-identification screen that drops any candidate carrying a uuid, 64-hex, @, +973 or 8-digit run. The metric list is closed: 16 learning.* names are always emitted, plus conditional skipped.* and capped.* rows, all disjoint from D17's names. Ruling (g) option (i): delete scripts/cron_few_shot_rotation.py and its test file. Their only importer is that test, and the script is the only code that writes feedback exemplars (each carrying a comparison uuid) under data/. ENABLE_FEWSHOT_ROTATION is also a legal fill-in flag; that machinery is left untouched. Base pass state was measured at ec747b49: 1 failed (the known d17 r9 CRLF baseline) and 604 passed; then 574 passed and 1 skipped.

open_questions: Q1: on a client construction failure, exit 1 after one ERROR line (as the brief says) or exit 0 with a WARNING (D17's resolve_client)? The spec follows the brief.
Q2: products_found in search_logs is the list of identified product names, so search_logs feeds only learning.searches.failed and is not used as a spec_missing input. Confirm.
Q3: include E4 (the docstring-only edit to test_exemplar_contamination.py) or rule it out? If ruled out, R26 scans import statements only.
Q4: map kb_feedback rows with field identity and verdict wrong to identity_wrong instead of fixing the bucket at n = 0 with source unavailable? The counts are identical today.
Q5: the spec chose LEARNING_MAX_ROWS = 5000 per table, clamped to 100..50000. Confirm.

Q6: the PostgREST JSON-path selects with an array index (full_response->overview->products->0->price->>source_method) were never run against the live project; owner step 3 (the one DRY run) is their only proof, and a null path falls back to unknown. Accept?

Q7: SAFE confirmation. The job reads user tables with the service-role client but writes only de-identified aggregates; privacy_policy.md:59 already covers de-identified statistics, so no legal text changes.

L3 identity_wrong is 0 until SF1 / CL3 or a kb_feedback writer lands
L4 the report file is ephemeral on Railway; the log is the durable copy and carries names and counts but not the exemplar verdict text
L5 the kb_* tables exist only after 045 is applied: until then their reads are counted skips and the apply-mode upsert fails with one WARNING
L6 the specs source axis is the fixed label specs; price clusters use source_method, not the retailer host
L7 kb_gaps carries no actor, so spec_missing clusters are never systematic
L8 no $0 DB-only replay exists; the offline proof is D22b
L9 the window is whole UTC days ending at the previous midnight; a capped table is read in id order, not newest first
L10 a conditional learning.skipped.* or learning.capped.* row from an earlier run the same day is not removed by a later run that day
L11 the category comes from full_response.category_used; a row without it is unknown
L12 ENABLE_FEWSHOT_ROTATION stays in the legal fill-in flag list as a name with no code
